title: Make a video call on WhatsApp
aliases: how do i make a video call on whatsapp
call someone with video on whatsapp
talk face to face on whatsapp
whatsapp pe video call kaise kare
whatsapp par video call karni hai

steps.instruction: Tap the chat with the person you want to call.
Tap the video camera icon at the top of the chat to start the call.

source_note: WhatsApp for iPhone, October 2026 layout on iOS 26/27, English. Assumes an existing individual chat, internet access, and camera and microphone access already allowed. Group calls use a different path. The current iPhone help article could not be retrieved; confirm the call icon, position and any confirmation screen on the installed version. Not checked on a phone. Reference: https://faq.whatsapp.com/iphone/voice-and-video-calls/how-to-make-a-video-call/
